# Part-Part-Whole Story Problem Frames

Subject: Math
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Problem Frames
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation Mathematics Learning Standards

## Short Description
Reusable addition and subtraction story frames with space for drawings, equations, and explanations.

## Alignment Note
Connects operations, representation, and early problem-solving standards.

## Classroom Use Case
Use during small group intervention or as a math center with counters.

## Preview Content
- There are __ red apples and __ green apples.
- Draw the two parts.
- Equation: __ + __ = __

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
